meta.title: GAM commands: Google Workspace cheatsheet (GAM7)
meta.description: GAM7 cheatsheet: the GAM commands for Google Workspace (users, groups, Gmail, Drive, calendars), with concrete examples and instant search.
meta.intro: Search a GAM command ('delegate', 'vacation', 'transfer drive'): every command has an example to copy (hand-written for the common ones), and every entry links to the original GAM wiki page, the only source of truth.
meta.card: GAM7 commands to administer Google Workspace: users, groups, Drive, Gmail, calendars, devices.

source.name: GAM-team/GAM (wiki)
source.note: Only short excerpts are reproduced, with a link to the original page; the wiki is not reproduced. Project independent of Google.

meta.notice: Unofficial index, generated from the GAM wiki; the examples (addresses at example.com) and the descriptions are added by me: hand-written for the common commands, built from the wiki syntax for the others (minimal form, fictitious values; an unknown parameter stays written <Like this>). Syntaxes are abbreviated: open the wiki page for the full, up-to-date definition, and test on a test user or organizational unit first.
